dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not sure I'd want the responsibility...

dialogues.speaker: Zaitseva
dialogues.text: I completely understand! Simply explaining beauty to those tasteless yahoos is exhausting, let alone doing anything else.

dialogues.speaker: Zaitseva
dialogues.text: If those trend-chasing sheeple were actually to hitch themselves to the bandwagon of Aino's brilliance... Ugh, I shudder to think! True art is best left to people like us to enjoy in peace.
